'''''Wanderer''''' was a [[Far*Reach IV PQR]] survey vessel in the service of the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Brektate]] at the time of its crash on the crystalline [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Isis/Legends|Isis]].

==Characteristics==
It carried a repulsorlift [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]].
